note: VERIFIES a fix already present in this file, not new work: LoadLegacyLists (legacy city.roads/bridges/tunnels width is ALREADY METRES per src/roads.js's own header comment and tools/build_map.py's literal ROAD_W table; only coordinates are decimetre) and MergeRoadNet (net-derived entries' width IS decimetre, divided by 10) now match src/roads.js:19-94's mergeRoadNet exactly — no uniform rescale, because the two sources are genuinely different units. This resolved a real parity bug: before this fix, C# divided EVERY legacy width by 10, which (a) shrank every legacy road below every threshold this file and src/citymap.js's _buildRoads gate on (sidewalk >=5.5, verge >=12, markings >=7.5/16), breaking legacy road-deck geometry everywhere outside the Tbilisi net bbox, and (b) coincidentally let VegetationRenderer's 6-13m street-tree filter reject every legacy road, filling its 45,000 cap entirely from the curated net — denser-looking, but reached by a unit bug, not a feature. DECISION: match src/roads.js exactly (the JS is the spec) rather than keep the visually denser pre-fix result. INVESTIGATED whether the resulting divergence (which STREETS get trees) touches real Tbilisi: no — with width read correctly, all 45,000 capped street-tree points come from LEGACY entries (legacy walked before net in mergeRoadNet; enough legacy residential/tertiary roads exist to exhaust the cap before a net-derived entry is ever reached — true in src/citymap.js itself, not a port artifact). Of those, ~2.7% (~1,200/45,000) land within 20km of the Tbilisi origin (the old, coarser per-highway-class width guess, not the curated roadnet.json network), ~29.5% land 20-50km out, ~68% land beyond 50km — all in public/tbilisi/mapmeta.json's other 5 city bboxes (batumi/kutaisi/gori/rustavi/kazbegi, up to 265km, deliberately NOT bbox-filtered per the user: only Tbilisi is playable today but the rest unlock later). The curated real-Tbilisi street network itself gets zero street trees either way — a cap-exhaustion property of src/citymap.js, out of scope here (not this task's file to edit).
